name: Varedo (Italy)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Varedo (quartered, with a cow, a fleur-de-lis and stars) within branches, with the inscription Città di Varedo in black beneath.
history: Municipal flag of Varedo, a comune in Lombardy; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Varedo arms — quartered with a cow, a fleur-de-lis and stars, crowned, within branches
inscription Città di Varedo beneath the arms
